description_excerpt: Job Description ABOUT THE ROLE The Technology Technician/Technologist acts as a vital technical liaison and project driver between the production floor, cross-functional teams (Prepress, Sample Development, Planning, and Production), and external stakeholders. This role is responsible for overseeing all technical aspects - including process attributes, sample/machine specifications, and quality control systems.
